variant_definitions.question: Full method with the same instrumentation.
Repeated construction and the same restart mixture without the local phase.
Contribution of admissibility memory; retain hash maintenance to control its storage overhead.
Contribution of swap candidates; preserve additions and removals.
Contribution of neutral and negative local moves; restart on an empty admissible neighborhood.
Contribution of occasional reconstruction from empty.
Contribution of perturbing the incumbent versus independent reconstructions.

schedule_policy: Preserve the 126 pilot cells; continue the same RNG after its 18 pilot shuffles to append 294 new cells.
target_scope: Frozen published and maximum nominal baseline objectives; neither implies optimality.
timing_scope: Full per-cell search wall budget. Nominal observations exclude overshoot. Misses are censored at their own horizon. No pooled mixed-budget time.
inference: Ten paired seeds on six difficulty-selected development instances. The first three seeds are inherited from the instrumented pilot; no holdout or benchmark-wide superiority claim follows from this development panel.
